from pathlib import Path
program_dir = Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792485222/attempts/83275b2e45034ad1868f4c57ede5090a/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code = '''from collections import defaultdict, deque

def components(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    out = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == 2 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while q:
                y, x = q.pop()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    yy, xx = y+dy, x+dx
                    if 0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and (yy,xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx] == color:
                        seen.add((yy,xx))
                        q.append((yy,xx))
            out.append((color, cells))
    return out

def transform(grid):
    objs = components(grid)
    by_color = defaultdict(list)
    for color, cells in objs:
        by_color[color].append(cells)
    if not objs:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    # The largest coherent color patch is the color key; recolor the closest
    # patch from the most repeated other color to that key color.
    anchor_color = max(by_color, key=lambda col: max(map(len, by_color[col])))
    anchors = by_color[anchor_color]
    anchor = max(anchors, key=len)
    ay = sum(r for r,c in anchor) / len(anchor)
    ax = sum(c for r,c in anchor) / len(anchor)
    candidates = [(col, cells) for col, groups in by_color.items() if col != anchor_color for cells in groups]
    if not candidates:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    counts = {col: len(groups) for col, groups in by_color.items() if col != anchor_color}
    max_count = max(counts.values())
    candidates = [(col, cells) for col, cells in candidates if counts[col] == max_count]
    # When repeated objects are congruent, the remote copy is the one singled out.
    def norm(cells):
        r0 = min(r for r,c in cells); c0 = min(c for r,c in cells)
        return frozenset((r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in cells)
    chosen = None
    if len(candidates) > 1:
        shapes = [norm(cells) for _, cells in candidates]
        if len(set(shapes)) == 1:
            chosen = max(candidates, key=lambda item: (sum(r for r,c in item[1])/len(item[1])-ay)**2 + (sum(c for r,c in item[1])/len(item[1])-ax)**2)
    if chosen is None:
        chosen = min(candidates, key=lambda item: (sum(r for r,c in item[1])/len(item[1])-ay)**2 + (sum(c for r,c in item[1])/len(item[1])-ax)**2)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r,c in chosen[1]:
        out[r][c] = anchor_color
    return out
